rule: Default plugins must never silently replace a claimed real result with fabricated/example data. Simulations and generative fiction are allowed only when the product surface explicitly says what they are.

doge_core.source: AstrBot runtime, OS, local aggregate counters

doge_math.source: local algorithms; OEIS/pi remote services where selected

doge_misc.source: local codec, Open-Meteo, NASA APOD/API page, Bing, OneBot action
doge_misc.fallback: real alternate source or explicit error

doge_typeset.fallback: alternate real renderer or explicit error

doge_playground.source: local numerical/visual algorithms; /fourier uses user image/SVG/text -> contour extraction -> complex DFT epicycles
doge_playground.fallback: explicit error; /fourier never substitutes a generic FFT spectrum

doge_papers.fallback: another real registry or explicit error

doge_games.source: local game engines; RNG is game state, not claimed real-world data

doge_arena.source: 238 exact v4 /wp cards + explicit arena modifiers + configured chat provider for narration
doge_arena.fallback: no replacement cards; provider failure is explicit

doge_social.source: Doge-vendored emoji/sticker backend derived from astrbot_plugin_stealer plus pinned group-chat air-reading engine; the vendored backend exposes no commands or LLM tools itself
doge_social.fallback: fail closed by group allow-list for emoji/sticker automation; all manual emoji/sticker operations go through /social emoji; /meme remains independently owned by doge_memes

doge_linguistics.source: Tangut dictionary/Yindian/RRPL/pinned Cthuvian translator; Tangut exact output is dictionary-grounded and relaxed completion can only select existing dictionary candidates or omit function words. Cthuvian formal forward commands accept English only; for natural-language non-English requests, the ambient Agent itself performs the faithful English translation before invoking the command, with no separate translation-model call. High register resolves English word-by-word against pinned RC-1 resources; all genuinely missing single English words are proposed together in one ordered structured DeepSeek batch, validated independently, then committed atomically.
doge_linguistics.fallback: Tangut relaxed output remains provenance-labeled. Cthuvian low register may use reversible sealed encoding; Cthuvian high register has no sealed/chunk/lexical fallback, and any unresolved batch proposal fails closed without partial registry writes.

doge_media.source: AnimeTrace or pinned local mirage algorithm

doge_code.fallback: protocol change/error is explicit; never execute on host

doge_lookup.fallback: another labeled real source or explicit error

doge_ai.source: pinned micrograd/minBPE; user-input/local generated experiment data

doge_chaoli.source: chaoli.club via dedicated local Chaoli SOCKS/VLESS egress and curl_cffi Chrome-compatible HTTP fingerprint; search uses Chaoli/esoTalk native POST AJAX with page session/token; forum-owner daily digest uses the provided #今日活跃 conversations/index.json/all semantics through the same dedicated proxy, obtaining the live ET token and POSTing search=#今日活跃 to the official JSON endpoint so structured results are returned without the Cloudflare-blocked query-string GET; a persisted per-day pool is fed by realtime push diffs and is used only when the official daily JSON POST is unavailable, with native #今日活跃 AJAX POST as empty-pool/downtime repair; thread-page /pN#pPOSTID and /conversation/post/POSTID are fetched as exact locators so page-2+ floors are not collapsed to page 1; theme cards require ID/channel consistency and separately bind first author vs last replier; floor parser uses real displayed floor numbers, preserves deleted-floor placeholders, and separates blockquote authors/content from current-floor text; user names are verified against real profile titles
doge_chaoli.fallback: daily JSON Cloudflare/unavailability falls back to the locally maintained day pool rather than fabricating activity; realtime push remains independent. Fail closed on unknown/mismatched board, inconsistent theme/card IDs, ambiguous duplicate usernames, unavailable exact floor pages, or unbound activity records; no nickname-to-real-identity inference, cross-author quote flattening, silent board fallback, or synthetic forum facts.

doge_pixiv.source: Pixiv anonymous Web AJAX through the isolated local Pixiv proxy: exact-tag search exposes permanent/recent popular seeds; Pixiv recommendation expands permanent seeds and is re-filtered by the original tag; latest stream is fallback; selected works are revalidated by official detail fields and downloaded original-first from i.pximg.net; Lolicon remains random/artist/fault fallback
doge_pixiv.fallback: hard reject x_restrict!=0 and ai_type=2; if official Web/original CDN and allowed Lolicon fallback fail, return explicit error rather than synthesize or substitute unrelated artwork

doge_music.source: NetEase Cloud Music public HTTPS search endpoint (music.163.com/api/search/get/web); selected song IDs are sent through AstrBot/OneBot native NetEase music cards (music type=163), without downloading or transcoding whole songs
doge_music.fallback: fail closed when NetEase search is unavailable or returns no bound song ID; search results are presented for explicit user selection, and no LLM guessing, synthetic song metadata, third-party playback API, lyrics image, or hot-comment substitution is used

doge_memes.source: pinned astrbot_plugin_meme_generator / meme_generator template corpus and its runtime parameter collector; it resolves current/reply images, explicit QQ mentions, then auto-fills current sender and bot avatars when image slots remain
doge_memes.fallback: explicit template/resource/error result; never ask for a retrievable sender avatar merely because template detail reports an image requirement; never substitute the collected QQ emoji/sticker library

doge_minecraft.source: v4 mcstatus Java server query route, upgraded to mcstatus 14.2.0; per-session persisted server registry and local Pillow status-card renderer
doge_minecraft.fallback: unreachable servers remain stored and are reported unavailable; no fabricated player/version/latency data
